raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-15 the v2 collector writes txn_ts in UTC, while legacy writes America/Chicago local time, so the two are mixed in one column. v2 transactions made after 18:00 Chicago land on the next UTC date and show up as 00:00-06:00 rows. This explains the odd-hours alerts and the thin 2026-01-19 date. The fix converts v2 timestamps to Chicago local time (UTC-6; all data is in January, so no DST) in silver_transactions. The gold tables read from silver, so they correct themselves.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.86,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
